answer: Work waits on the yarrow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pearl of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the oasis is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust. Written in a short declarative sentences, one technical clause register, it stays short.
